title: How to Apply
subtitle: Follow these simple steps to get your UAE visa

steps.title: Choose Your Visa
steps.description: Select the visa type that matches your travel purpose and duration.

steps.title: Fill the Form
steps.description: Complete our secure online application form with your personal details.

steps.title: Upload Documents
steps.description: Upload clear copies of your passport, photo, and other required documents.

steps.title: Make Payment
steps.description: Pay securely using credit card, debit card, or other available methods.

steps.title: Receive Your Visa
steps.description: Get your approved visa via email within the selected processing time.

tips.title: Application Tips
tips.tip1: Ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months
tips.tip2: Use a recent photo with white background
tips.tip4: Apply at least 1 week before your travel date
